title: FiveLetterWords Wordle Research Corpus (v2026-09-01)
description:
Independent research by FiveLetterWords.io. Not affiliated with or endorsed by The New York Times. Wordle is a trademark of The New York Times Company.

Versioned, checksummed research corpus behind FiveLetterWords.io: a six-turn opener benchmark for all 14,855 accepted Wordle guesses, spoiler-safe puzzle difficulty rows (answer words omitted), one-slot trap families, first-turn feedback branches, an opening-pair frontier, aggregate letter frequencies and repeat statistics, a Wordle #2000 fact sheet and a full data dictionary. Every table is supplied as CSV and JSON; every file is byte-identical to the canonical release and listed with its SHA-256 checksum in data/manifest.json.

Release: v2026-09-01 (published 2026-09-01; answer-history data through 2026-08-31; schema version 3).
Canonical release page: https://www.fiveletterwords.io/data/releases/v2026-09-01/
All FiveLetterWords research data: https://www.fiveletterwords.io/data

Spoiler policy: no file maps dates to answer words. Solver pressure is a repeatable model comparison, not a measure of average human difficulty.

Not included: the preserved simulation answer-pool snapshot (full-game-answer-pool.txt), which remains under upstream source terms and is not covered by CC BY.
